structural_epochs.condition: The demand base is migrating toward stock operation: urban population still expanded and more than 240,000 old communities were renovated during the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan, but regulated or negotiated fees and continuing labor input prevent recurring demand from guaranteeing margin recovery.
observations: Urban population increased by 10.30 million in 2025 and urbanization reached 67.89%; old-community renovation covered more than 240,000 communities and 40 million households during the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan.
Recurring residential service demand is structurally more durable than developer delivery, while monetization remains constrained by fee adjustment and collection economics.
Low-return operators can remain in the market without a heavy-asset capacity exit, so supply does not mechanically contract when returns weaken.

structural_epochs.condition: China property services moved out of a developer-delivery-led expansion epoch: 2025 residential starts and completions fell 19.8% and 20.2%, and the contraction continued in the first five months of 2026, reducing the flow of low-acquisition-cost new residential mandates and development-chain services.
observations: Residential starts fell 19.8% and completions fell 20.2% in 2025; January-May 2026 starts and completions fell 23.4% and 25.0% year on year.
The evidence establishes a shrinking new-project feeder, not the disappearance of recurring property-service demand.
No concentration conclusion is asserted from the admitted sources.

structural_epochs.condition: Growth is increasingly sought in institutional property, city public services and smart engineering, where demand may be resilient but competition, procurement regulation, annual performance tests, working-capital funding, project acceptance and collection determine whether revenue becomes owner cash.

representative_peers.why_representative: Broader institutional portfolio and operating density differ from Zhonghai's disclosed city-project mix; use as a mechanism benchmark, not a copied margin.
